_note: Floors for scripts/check_evals.sh, measured on mlx-community/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-4bit on 2026-08-15. Each floor is the measured score minus one iteration's worth of slack, because every suite samples only 5 iterations per case and a single flaky iteration is normal — the actor suite scored 100.0% and then 95.0% back to back with no code change between them. A real regression moves more than one run and still trips these. Re-measure and edit deliberately when a change legitimately moves a number; never lower one just to get green.

coach._measured: 63.5% (146/230), 46 cases x 5; one run of slack = 0.43 points
coach._history: Was 98.7 against a 16-case set that scored 100.0% (80/80). The suite then had only 6 Japanese cases and was measuring the English side plus whatever Japanese had already been fixed. 30 Japanese N5-N3 cases were added on 2026-08-15 and the honest score fell to 63.5%. The floor dropped because the ruler got longer, NOT because the coach got worse — the 16 original cases still score 80/80.
coach._where_the_loss_is: 16 of the 23 new error cases score 0/5, 13 of those by answering 'Perfectly natural!' to a real mistake. Blind classes: を/に and に/で particle choice, transitive/intransitive pairs (つく/つける, 始まる/始める), たい past tense, counters, register. All 12 clean cases score 5/5, so this is pure under-correction, not over-correction.
coach._regression_would_look_like: a drop with the clean cases newly failing — that would be over-correction, a worse failure than the misses this number already reflects

judge._measured: 92.3% (120/130), 26 cases x 5; one run of slack = 0.77 points
judge._regression_would_look_like: 84.6% with 3 false negatives — the OPEN-01 context bug returning
judge._remaining: case 22 is the one false negative, case 5 the accepted false positive

actor._measured: 100.0% (20/20) then 95.0% (19/20) on consecutive runs, 4 cases x 5; one run = 5 points, so this floor allows the observed flake plus one

moods._measured: 100.0% (18/18), 6 moods x 3 turns; one turn of slack = 5.6 points
